description: Get percentile metrics over calls (POST /v1/query/percentiles). metric = 'latency' (ms) or 'cost' (USD); either a single value for the whole range, or a time series with groupBy='day'/'hour'/'minute'. Example phrasing: "daily p95 latency trend for last week". Percentiles are computed with the nearest-rank method.

groupBy.description: Time-series bucketing (omit = one value for the whole range, 'day' = daily, 'hour' = hourly, 'minute' = per minute)

startTime.description: Range start ISO timestamp (UTC; omit = all time)

tzOffsetMinutes.description: groupBy='day' only. Same local-day bucketing as aggregate_calls (minutes, Tokyo = +540, -840..840). Omit = UTC days

name: get_percentiles
